hostname R1-CORE
!
enable secret 9 $9$CiscoEnableHashXyZ
enable password PlainEnablePw1
username netadmin privilege 15 secret 9 $9$UserHashAbC123
service password-encryption
ip domain name lab.local
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/0
 description Uplink-to-ISP
 ip address 10.0.0.1 255.255.255.252
 ip ospf message-digest-key 1 md5 OspfMd5Key77
 no shutdown
!
router ospf 1
 network 10.0.0.0 0.0.0.3 area 0
!
router bgp 65001
 neighbor 10.0.0.2 remote-as 65002
 neighbor 10.0.0.2 password BgpNeighPw99
!
snmp-server community PubCommRO ro
snmp-server community PrivCommRW rw
tacacs-server host 192.0.2.10 key TacacsKey55
radius-server key RadiusKey66
crypto key generate rsa modulus 2048
ip route 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 10.0.0.2
!
line vty 0 4
 password VtyLinePw42
 login
 transport input ssh
line con 0
 secret ConsoleSecret8
!
